title: Development of iodine cells for the Subaru HDS and the Okayama HIDES I
what_was_studied: Iodine-cell hardware and instrumental-profile tests for HIDES and HDS
numerical_result: The cells were optimized for solar-type-star RV work and the study reports configuration-dependent instrumental profiles
remaining_question: How do the original slit and later fibre-feed line-spread functions differ?

title: Radial-Velocity Variability of G-Type Giants: First Three Years of the Okayama Planet Search Program
what_was_studied: Iodine-cell monitoring of 57 G-type giants during the programme's first three years
numerical_result: For stars with B-V below 1.0 the scatter was typically about 10 m/s and the most stable cases reached 6 to 8 m/s; redder giants commonly showed about 20 m/s scatter
remaining_question: Giant-star oscillations and activity must be separated from instrumental repeatability

title: A Fiber Link between the Okayama 188-cm Telescope and the High-Dispersion Spectrograph, HIDES
what_was_studied: Fibre feed added to improve throughput while retaining radial-velocity capability
numerical_result: The high-efficiency mode reaches resolving power above 50000 and maximum throughput near 9 percent; stable-star sequences over about one year reached a few m/s and the practical efficiency exceeded the slit mode by more than a factor of two
remaining_question: What offset and line-spread-function change separates slit and fibre epochs?

title: HIDES instrument page
what_was_studied: Current instrument description and available modes
numerical_result: The official page describes HIDES on the 1.88 m telescope with slit and fibre observing modes
